note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry gives Isle of Man no IBAN of its own: the prefix GB of United Kingdom includes it, so an account there is numbered as one in United Kingdom.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), its text release: the copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (registry.txt, commit 81b6dbcb, 2025-02-18; its latest country update December 2024), read there because swift.com answered every request with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-30
sources.said: IBAN prefix country code (ISO 3166): GB | Country code includes other countries/territories: IM, JE, GG
